cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The missing savings are a banking complication. Please keep our anniversary reservation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It's coming back Friday. Last time we discussed her, you asked for separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me handle the complication. I'd like us still sharing a table when the money arrives.

confusable: D66 acts authorised to suppress checking; D87 concealment specifically serves fear relationship cannot withstand another conflict.
comparison: Letter alternative withholds physical evidence after unpacking; savings alternative monopolises bank contact while keeping a shared dinner.
seedUse: Missing savings, sister loan, Friday return, separate bedrooms and bank call derive from D87-b; S03 adds reconciliation and contact-role corrections.
